title: Systematic Evidence Synthesis
description: Synthesize a body of evidence: verify source independence across included studies, search for unpublished nulls, resolve outcome-definition conflicts, and run adversarial review before a tentative synthesis claim.

common_failure_modes.note: Included studies share one primary chain; synthesis overstates independence.
Unpublished nulls and contradictory studies excluded.
No methodological critique of the synthesis.

escalation_conditions.when: candidate claim ceiling would exceed TENTATIVE
source dependence unresolved across included studies

stop_criteria.condition: independence verified, nulls searched, conflicts resolved, adversarial review passed
primary studies inaccessible or evidence body too thin after search
